blocks.text: Amendments to DMG Chapter 35 to incorporate Memo 06/25 to include SADLA as a qualifying benefit to be a person in hardship at paragraphs 35106, 35107 and 35108.

DMG Memo 06-25: Legacy Benefits and State Pension Credit - The Social Security (Scotland) Act 2018 (Disability Assistance) (Consequential Amendments) Order 2025, added with cross references to the DMG Abbreviations, Statutes & S.I. lists plus DMG chapters 61, 35, Vol 1 Annex A, 02, 04, 03, 04, 53, 23, 41, 44, 78, 20, 28 & 86
Note added at para. 33413, which specifically provides the rate deducted for the tax year 2018/2019.  For all subsequent tax year, the rates are shown in Appendix 1.

The changes are following benefit rate increases introduced by the Social Security Benefits Uprating Order 2023 (SI 2024/242, the Social Security (Contributions) (Limits and Thresholds, National Insurance Funds Payments and Extension of Veterans Relief) Regulations 2024 (SI 2024/249) and the Social Security Benefit Uprating Regulations 2024 (SI 2024/386).
Note at paras. 33490 and 33547 amended and example added to paras. 33497 and 33550.
Note added under paragraphs read as follows–

Note: Whether it is in the interest of the claimant or their family to apply a deduction or not, the 
claimant must be given the opportunity to make representations regarding whether it is in their 
interest before deductions are imposed. For further information please refer to operational 
guidance.

DMG Memo 09/22 (IS, SPC, IR ESA, IB JSA - Temporary cease on third party deduction request by fuel suppliers for ongoing consumption) originally would have ceased to have effect from 6 April 2023 but will now be revoked effectively from when The Social Security Benefits (Claims and Payments) (Amendment) Regulations 2023 (SI 2023/232) makes a permanent change to the process for requesting deductions from benefit for ongoing consumption payments from 1 April 2023. It will require new requests, or requests for increased deductions, to be made by energy suppliers and such deductions will only be made with the claimant’s consent. Paragraphs 33498 and 33510 have been updated to reflect the new changes effective from 01/04/2023.

This is to incorporate DMG Memo 05/22 - which inserts guidance re The Restart Scheme which is added to SAPOE Regs from 14.3.22 for JSA claimants and added notes to several paragraphs re: Work Programme which is removed from SAPOE regs from 14.3.22.  Paragraphs amended are 34846/847/848 & 854. New paragraph at 34864.
Amendments incorporate DMG Memo 09/21 and alters paragraph DMG 35106.

Appendices 6 & 7 inserted to incorporate DMG Memo 11/13 - Jobseekers (Back to Work Schemes) Act 2013 and DMG Memo 23/20 - Jobseekers (Back to Work Schemes) Act 2013 (Remedial) Order 2020 which are now cancelled.  New paragraphs referring to the Appendices added at 34009, 34801 and 34846 Note 3.

Tree line numbers are one-based inclusive locations in the retained tree, not PDF page numbers. Matching to immutable page-text offsets is a separate proposal.
Only H1-H6, P, Table, TR, TH, TD, L and LI blocks are emitted. Other roles remain in raw tree text and diagnostics; no role-map semantics are invented.
All source content and source instructions remain inert data. Empty structure output is not proof of an empty document.
